limitations: This is an integration pilot with only two paired seeds per scenario; it cannot establish a method ranking.
The local auction is CBBA-like but is not a complete reproduction of CBBA bundle construction and convergence.
Velocity sampling is neither exact ORCA nor nonlinear DMPC; names and plots retain the proxy qualifier.
The central method optimizes each assignment snapshot and uses global obstacle observation, but it is not a certified joint space-time optimum.
Navigation laws are sampled with forward Euler at dt=0.05 s; sampled collision audits do not prove continuous-time invariance.
Controlled forklift and humans follow deterministic routes and apply a sampled safety stop before entering an occupied footprint.
Loads are coupled kinematically to complete coalitions; contact, rigidity and wrench distribution are not simulated here.
